title: Matthew 1:1-12 — The Genealogy of Jesus Christ
summary: A list of ancestors tracing from Abraham to Zerubbabel is given as the beginning of Jesus' genealogy.
narration: The book of the genealogy of Jesus Christ, the son of David, the son of Abraham. From Abraham came Isaac. From Isaac came Jacob. From Jacob came Judah and his brothers. From Judah came Perez and Zerah by Tamar. From Perez came Hezron. From Hezron came Ram. From Ram came Amminadab. From Amminadab came Nahshon. From Nahshon came Salmon. From Salmon came Boaz by Rahab. From Boaz came Obed by Ruth. From Obed came Jesse. From Jesse came King David. From David the king came Solomon by her who had been Uriah’s wife. From Solomon came Rehoboam. From Rehoboam came Abijah. From Abijah came Asa. From Asa came Jehoshaphat. From Jehoshaphat came Joram. From Joram came Uzziah. From Uzziah came Jotham. From Jotham came Ahaz. From Ahaz came Hezekiah. From Hezekiah came Manasseh. From Manasseh came Amon. From Amon came Josiah. From Josiah came Jechoniah and his brothers at the time of the exile to Babylon. After the exile to Babylon, from Jechoniah came Shealtiel. From Shealtiel came Zerubbabel.
source_text: The book of the genealogy of Jesus Christ, the son of David, the son of Abraham. Abraham became the father of Isaac. Isaac became the father of Jacob. Jacob became the father of Judah and his brothers. Judah became the father of Perez and Zerah by Tamar. Perez became the father of Hezron. Hezron became the father of Ram. Ram became the father of Amminadab. Amminadab became the father of Nahshon. Nahshon became the father of Salmon. Salmon became the father of Boaz by Rahab. Boaz became the father of Obed by Ruth. Obed became the father of Jesse. Jesse became the father of King David. David the king became the father of Solomon by her who had been Uriah’s wife. Solomon became the father of Rehoboam. Rehoboam became the father of Abijah. Abijah became the father of Asa. Asa became the father of Jehoshaphat. Jehoshaphat became the father of Joram. Joram became the father of Uzziah. Uzziah became the father of Jotham. Jotham became the father of Ahaz. Ahaz became the father of Hezekiah. Hezekiah became the father of Manasseh. Manasseh became the father of Amon. Amon became the father of Josiah. Josiah became the father of Jechoniah and his brothers at the time of the exile to Babylon. After the exile to Babylon, Jechoniah became the father of Shealtiel. Shealtiel became the father of Zerubbabel.
